TinyMDM kiosk setup · Code 1, then Code 2

Use a computer or second screen to show these codes while setting up the tablet.

Code 1 · Enroll and install in kiosk mode

On a fresh tablet’s Android welcome screen, tap the same spot six times to open the provisioning QR scanner. Connect Wi-Fi when prompted, then scan the live enrollment QR below. Complete management setup and stay online while TinyMDM installs the assigned app and applies kiosk mode.

If the tablet is already enrolled, keep its enrollment and app data; skip Code 1 and verify its kiosk policy. Do not reset it for this checklist.

Open or refresh the live TinyMDM enrollment QR ↗

The enrollment code expires after 24 hours. Reload this page or open the link above for a fresh code. If the embedded page is blank, use the link.

Confirm TinyMDM assigns the Factories group and Patagonia Install policy, and the app runs in kiosk mode. The tablet must report 0.1.58 / code 58 for these checks. If it installs an older version, ask the administrator to update the TinyMDM assignment before continuing.
